name: Coffee order
instructions: Capture drink_style (drip / americano / latte), size (small / medium / large), milk (regular / oat / almond / soy / none), and syrup (vanilla / caramel / hazelnut / none). Don't ask for milk on a black drip unless the patron mentions it. If size is large and milk is not oat, casually mention oat milk pairs nicely with a large — once, not twice; the patron can decline. When you have all four slots, move to confirmation.

condition.expression: Patron has provided drink style, size, milk, and syrup choice (or explicitly skipped syrup).
Patron changed their mind, asked to cancel, or wants to leave.
